title: diospyros ngii
intro: Diospyros ngii, commonly known as the Philippine ebony, is a species of evergreen tree native to the Philippines. It is valued for its timber and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Diospyros ngii include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent to alleviate conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Diospyros ngii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
